WARNING: contains reference answers and re-derived values: coordinator and adjudicator only

rules.audit_rule: round 2 (10 more, fixed seed) only for an audit whose round 1 overturns >= 1 case; no third round
rules.sample: AUTO_CORRECT iff both batches match the reference (Optimal, no issue, not LOW, output consistent); otherwise ADJUDICATE
rules.screening: unsampled IndustryOR: SCREEN_FLAG (adjudicated) iff A and B agree with each other and neither matches the reference; otherwise SCREEN_KEEP (original reference kept)
rules.type_label: ADJUDICATE iff either batch says NL_* or LOW type confidence (or a type field is missing/invalid); equal LP/MILP/IP labels -> AUTO; differing LP/MILP/IP labels -> the label of the only batch whose objective matches the reference (AUTO_BY_REFERENCE), otherwise LINEAR_UNRESOLVED (UNRESOLVED)
